result.summary: Reduces log noise for unreachable SOCKS5 proxies and I2P SAM proxies. The initial connection or listen failure is logged as a warning, while repeated subsequent failures are demoted to debug level using LogWarnThenDebug.
result.problem: When a configured proxy is unreachable, node logs are repeatedly spammed on every retry: SOCKS5 logs connect failures at info level and I2P repeatedly logs listening failures as errors.
evidence: PR description: 'Until now every failed attempt logged the connect() failure at info level, and I2P additionally logged "Couldn't listen" as an error. Now the first failure is logged as a warning and later ones only at debug level.'
PR description cites consensus in #36759 to adopt LogWarnThenDebug for Tor control connection attempts.
result.card: Reduces log noise when SOCKS5 or I2P SAM proxies are unreachable. Every failed retry currently logs at info or error level, spamming debug.log. This change issues a warning on the first failure and demotes subsequent failures to debug level. PR #36970 is stacked on top of this PR.

risk.why: A bug in the logging logic could prematurely silence failure notices or fail to suppress repeated log spam.
